mapper.select: SELECT id, pro_id AS proId, title, content, image, cause, improvement, practice, category FROM posts ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, pro_id AS proId, title, content, image, cause, improvement, practice, category FROM posts WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts ( pro_id, title, content, image, cause, improvement, practice, category ) VALUES ( #{proId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{image}, #{cause}, #{improvement}, #{practice}, #{category} )
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image = #{image}, cause = #{cause}, improvement = #{improvement}, practice = #{practice}, category = #{category} WHERE id = #{id}
